# Hybrid Bootstrap Admin Template

Original template: https://github.com/learning-zone/website-templates/tree/master/hybrid-bootstrap-admin-template
Original author: [WebThemez](https://webthemez.com/)
License specified in the original stylesheet: [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

Exst Arcade adapts the template's dashboard structure (wrapper, top navigation, sidebar navigation, page wrapper and Bootstrap grid). The original Bootstrap and custom stylesheets are included unmodified; arcade.css provides a new responsive dark theme. Charts and admin widgets have been replaced with a playable game library.

Bootstrap v3.2.0 is copyright 2011–2014 Twitter, Inc. and licensed under MIT; see the header in bootstrap.css.
